invariants.claim: A successful initialization operates on storage whose initialized flag was false, is called by the immutable factory, and leaves initialized true, so that storage instance cannot pass the initializer gate again.
invariants.evidence: target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L176-L179; the implementation is separately locked at L164-L165.

invariants.claim: The implementation-baked factory identity is the RaffleFactory that deployed the implementation used by every clone.
On success sponsor, sponsorRecipient, protocolTreasury, and prizeToken are nonzero.

On success sponsor, protocolTreasury, and sponsorRecipient are not classified as the current clone, factory, quote token, wrapper, prospective prize token, implementation, or a code-bearing registered same-factory raffle.
Successful initialization stores all eight clone-specific configuration fields exactly from params and sets status to AwaitingPrize.
The fresh clone is not registered until initialization returns, but the destination classifier rejects the current clone directly through address(this).
Initialization creates configuration but no prize custody; activation requires a later callback matching the stored token, token ID, sponsor, and factory operator.
